title: crew-refute-verdict
description: Output shape for a crew tier-2 refuter pass (docs/CREW_REFUTE.md). Field names are identical to the crew workflow's VERDICT_SCHEMA (docs/CREW_SESSIONS_PLAN.md §1). Deliberately avoids JSON Schema keywords the Codex CLI's structured-output mode does not support (pattern, minimum, minItems, format) — every object sets additionalProperties:false and lists every property as required, per OpenAI's strict-schema subset.

lens.description: One-line statement of what this pass checked — normally the brief's named constraints, verbatim or paraphrased. For a no-op run (empty diff), states that there was nothing to refute.

verdict.description: CONFIRMED only when findings contains at least one entry naming a concrete failure scenario with a file:line. Otherwise NOT-REFUTED. There is no third option — 'I have concerns' is not a verdict.

reviewedSha.description: The commit SHA (full or abbreviated hex) at the worktree HEAD this verdict was produced against.

findings.description: Empty when verdict is NOT-REFUTED. One entry per confirmed defect when verdict is CONFIRMED.

id.description: Short stable identifier for this finding, e.g. F1.

file.description: Repo-relative path the finding is anchored to.

line.description: 1-indexed line the finding is anchored to.

scenario.description: Concrete inputs/state -> wrong outcome or crash. Not a vague concern.
